description.description: A formal portrait of Kashyap 'Kash' Patel, an American attorney and former government official. He is standing in front of two flags: the American flag on the left and a blue flag with gold elements and stars on the right. An American flag pin is visible on his left lapel.

A head-and-shoulders professional portrait of a woman with blonde hair, smiling at the camera. She is wearing a dark blue or black top with decorative buttons. The background is a soft-focus, blurred office or city environment.
